en_title: Cyberpunk 2 Associate Director Says Half of Game's Quest Team Are Former Modders
subtitle: 从玩家到开发者
opus_summary: 《赛博朋克2》副游戏总监Pawel Sasko透露，任务团队约半数成员曾是MOD作者。他认为制作MOD是进入游戏开发行业的途径，工作室也始终尽力支持MOD社区。

paragraphs.en: Cyberpunk 2 associate game director Pawel Sasko revealed that a good chunk of the game’s staff are actually former modders who CD Projekt Red picked up to work on the highly-anticipated sequel.
paragraphs.cn: 《赛博朋克2》副游戏总监Pawel Sasko透露，开发团队中有相当一部分成员曾是MOD作者，CDPR招募了他们，共同开发这款备受期待的续作。

paragraphs.en: Sasko made these comments during one of CDPR’s REDstreams on October 21, where the team discussed the bevy of exciting new updates coming to Cyberpunk 2077 . As part of this discussion, they explained their decision to introduce cross-platform support for PlayStation 5, Nintendo Switch 2, and Xbox Series X|S, saying this was done both to keep the game fresh and to actively support the creativity of its modders.
paragraphs.cn: Sasko在10月21日的CDPR REDstreams直播中作出上述表态。团队在直播中介绍了《赛博朋克2077》即将迎来的诸多精彩更新，也解释了为何决定为PS5、Switch 2和XBOX Series提供跨平台支持：既是为了让游戏保持新鲜感，也是为了积极支持MOD作者发挥创意。

paragraphs.en: In fact, the good folks at CDPR have actually partnered with modders in the game’s community as part of these updates, and even credited them with helping keep the title afloat.
paragraphs.cn: 事实上，CDPR的开发者在制作这些更新时，已经与游戏社区的MOD作者展开合作，甚至称赞他们帮助这款游戏延续了下去。

paragraphs.en: “The modding community is really keeping the game alive,” Sasko said. “I’m very often looking at what our modders are doing, what they’re building. It’s very exciting. There’s so much creativity. We as a studio always try to support our modding community as much as we can.”
paragraphs.cn: Sasko说：「MOD社区确实在让这款游戏保持活力。我经常关注我们的MOD作者在做什么、制作什么内容。这让人非常兴奋，里面有太多创意了。作为工作室，我们始终尽可能地支持MOD社区。」

paragraphs.en: Adding onto this discussion, Sasko revealed that CDPR has sourced quite a few of its staff working on Cyberpunk 2 from the game’s modding scene, saying that around half of its quest team — designers who create a game’s objectives and storyline segments — are former modders.
paragraphs.cn: 谈到这里，Sasko进一步透露，CDPR从这款游戏的MOD社区招募了不少人参与《赛博朋克2》的开发。他表示，任务团队中约有一半成员曾是MOD作者，这些设计师负责制作游戏中的任务目标和剧情片段。

paragraphs.en: "A lot of modders, they were players who actually first played and actually got experience with customizing the game with the mods," he said. "For me, this is a foot-in-the-door technique, and a gateway into game dev," he continues. "You can see, and you can learn how things are made, how things can be built. We actually hired so many modders. I would say, at this point, half of the quest team is all former modders."
paragraphs.cn: 他说：「很多MOD作者最初都是玩家，他们先玩游戏，再通过MOD积累自定义游戏的经验。」他继续说道：「在我看来，这是敲门砖，也是进入游戏开发行业的一条途径。你可以观察、学习这些内容是如何制作出来的，以及可以如何构建。我们确实招募了很多MOD作者。可以说，目前任务团队中有一半成员都曾是MOD作者。」

paragraphs.en: While this isn’t a completely new revelation as far as CDPR is concerned (Sasko actually revealed this information back in 2024 ), it certainly couldn’t come at a funnier time, given the ongoing discussion around the differing sentiments toward community patches, mods, and emulation happening between Western players and Japanese fans on social media right now .
paragraphs.cn: 对CDPR而言，这并不算全新的消息，Sasko其实早在2024年就透露过此事。不过，这番话出现的时机实在颇为有趣：眼下，西方玩家与日本粉丝正在社交媒体上讨论双方对社区补丁、MOD和模拟器的不同态度。

paragraphs.en: It’s an exciting era for Cyberpunk chooms; Edgerunners 2 just released on Netflix to rave reviews, alongside a host of new additions to the actual game, which include a dual-wielding playstyle, fresh cyberware customization options, and even a mode that gives you a tour through Night City, on top of cute references to the anime spinoff.
paragraphs.cn: 对《赛博朋克》的各位好兄弟来说，这是个令人兴奋的时期。《赛博朋克：边缘行者2》刚刚在Netflix上线，收获如潮好评；游戏本身也新增了大量内容，包括双持玩法、新的义体自定义选项，甚至还有带你游览夜之城的模式，此外也加入了致敬衍生动画的趣味彩蛋。

paragraphs.en: You can read our review for Edgerunners 2 here , as well as our interviews with producer Bartozs Szytbor, who told us all about Roman’s backstory and why the show’s ending wasn’t what audiences anticipated .
paragraphs.cn: 你可以在这里阅读我们对《赛博朋克：边缘行者2》的评测，以及对制片人Bartozs Szytbor的采访。他向我们详细介绍了Roman的背景故事，以及这部剧的结局为何与观众预期不同。

paragraphs.en: Returning to Cyberpunk 2077 or playing it for the first time? We’ve got a new and improved Cyberpunk interactive map to help you find every mission, Iconic item, and collectible in the game. Plus, we’ve also got a full walkthrough for the base game, a Phantom Liberty walkthrough , and an overview of all the Cyberpunk 2077 endings so you don’t make a choice you regret. And we can’t ignore the various romance options you can smooch, which also impact how V’s story concludes.
paragraphs.cn: 准备重返《赛博朋克2077》，还是第一次游玩？我们全新改进的《赛博朋克》互动地图可以帮你找到游戏中的每个任务、每件不朽物品和每个收集品。此外，我们还准备了本体完整流程攻略、《往日之影》流程攻略，以及《赛博朋克2077》全部结局概览，帮你避免作出令自己后悔的选择。当然，也不能忘记那些可以与你接吻的恋爱对象，他们同样会影响V的故事如何收尾。
